reviews.title: Terrible and uncooperative.
reviews.text:
This app has a CRAZY amount of ads, lags, and crashes, that it makes the app unenjoyable for some users. And I also find that basically 9 tenths (or EVERYTHING) of the things in this app costs more than $4, which is incredibly selfish considering this is a public platform.

And the platform has a low amount of effort, which is important for public engagement in platforms, AND can conclude or escalate the service due to potential conflicts, and money loss.
I don’t know if this is just me, but this error has basically taken over my app.

Oh, and DON’T get me STARTED on ads.
Since this is a very lazy, and unreliable service, of course there are going to have ads that repeat 19 times. I had the same ad about 25 times about McDonald’s Snack Wrap, and it was annoying.

And some of your other stuff is actually ILLEGAL.
So I bought the “free” trial to read a story I was interested in, but when I tried again, nothing. (That’s THEFT.) So I tried to cancel since it said cancel at any time, but there was no way to cancel. You know how I said this service was lazy? Well, they were lazy enough to literally not create a way to cancel my trial. So not only do they WANT money like most companies/services, they’re STRICT about it, and I said STRICT.

But again, it might just be me, but this is still terribly stupid and unacceptable, and the creators still need to at least examine the issue before confirming that it’s just a bug, because my money is going down the drain rn, and I need to get it
